mapper.sql: j.id AS id, j.file_id AS file_id, j.printer_id AS printer_id, j.user_id AS user_id, j.operator_id AS operator_id, j.file_name_snapshot AS file_name_snapshot, j.printer_name_snapshot AS printer_name_snapshot, j.machine_number_snapshot AS machine_number_snapshot, j.creator_username_snapshot AS creator_username_snapshot, j.operator_username_snapshot AS operator_username_snapshot, j.retry_of_job_id AS retry_of_job_id, j.root_job_id AS root_job_id, j.attempt_number AS attempt_number, j.priority AS priority, j.status AS status, j.progress AS progress, j.started_at AS started_at, j.completed_at AS completed_at, j.error_reason AS error_reason, j.created_at AS created_at, j.updated_at AS updated_at, CASE WHEN j.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN COALESCE(j.file_name_snapshot, f.original_name) ELSE COALESCE(f.original_name, j.file_name_snapshot) END AS file_name, CASE WHEN j.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN COALESCE(j.printer_name_snapshot, p.name) ELSE COALESCE(p.name, j.printer_name_snapshot) END AS printer_name, CASE WHEN j.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN COALESCE(j.machine_number_snapshot, p.machine_number) ELSE COALESCE(p.machine_number, j.machine_number_snapshot) END AS machine_number, CASE WHEN j.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN COALESCE(j.creator_username_snapshot, creator_user.username) ELSE COALESCE(creator_user.username, j.creator_username_snapshot) END AS creator_username, CASE WHEN j.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN COALESCE(j.operator_username_snapshot, operator_user.username) ELSE COALESCE(operator_user.username, j.operator_username_snapshot) END AS operator_username, f.material_type AS material_type, f.nozzle_size AS nozzle_size

FROM farm_print_job j LEFT JOIN farm_print_file f ON f.id = j.file_id LEFT JOIN farm_printer p ON p.id = j.printer_id LEFT JOIN farm_user creator_user ON creator_user.id = j.user_id LEFT JOIN farm_user operator_user ON operator_user.id = j.operator_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE j.status = 'QUEUED'
AND j.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY j.priority DESC, j.created_at ASC, j.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE farm_print_job SET printer_id = #{printerId}, printer_name_snapshot = #{printerName}, machine_number_snapshot = #{machineNumber}, status = 'ASSIGNED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{jobId} AND printer_id IS NULL AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'PENDING', 'MANUAL')

UPDATE farm_print_job SET printer_id = #{printerId}, printer_name_snapshot = #{printerName}, machine_number_snapshot = #{machineNumber}, status = 'ASSIGNED', updated_at = datetime('now', '+8 hours') WHERE id = #{jobId} AND printer_id IS NULL AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'PENDING', 'MANUAL')
UPDATE farm_print_job SET root_job_id = id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{jobId} AND root_job_id IS NULL

mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO farm_print_job ( file_id, printer_id, user_id, operator_id, idempotency_key, file_name_snapshot, printer_name_snapshot, machine_number_snapshot, creator_username_snapshot, operator_username_snapshot, retry_of_job_id, root_job_id, attempt_number, priority, status, progress, started_at, completed_at, error_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{fileId}, NULL, #{userId}, NULL, NULL, #{fileNameSnapshot}, NULL, NULL, #{creatorUsernameSnapshot}, NULL, #{retryOfJobId}, #{rootJobId}, #{attemptNumber}, #{priority}, 'QUEUED', #{progress}, NULL, NULL, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO farm_print_job ( file_id, printer_id, user_id, operator_id, idempotency_key, file_name_snapshot, printer_name_snapshot, machine_number_snapshot, creator_username_snapshot, operator_username_snapshot, retry_of_job_id, root_job_id, attempt_number, priority, status, progress, started_at, completed_at, error_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{fileId}, NULL, #{userId}, NULL, NULL, #{fileNameSnapshot}, NULL, NULL, #{creatorUsernameSnapshot}, NULL, #{retryOfJobId}, #{rootJobId}, #{attemptNumber}, #{priority}, 'QUEUED', #{progress}, NULL, NULL, NULL, datetime('now', '+8 hours'), datetime('now', '+8 hours') )
